items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: he told me it was Jimmy Noon... So, he let me use the clarinet and I used it for two nights

ctx.x: The First of all, one thing I had last time which I didn't ask you about was, apparently you've got Jimmy Moon's cloud hands. Can you say about how you got that or what the circumstances were on that? Yes, go ahead.

Well, my client and I had a rubber, a foil rubber client and it fell and it broke a piece off the ring. I brought it to the millage store in Los Angeles, on Vine Street. And asked them, could they fix it? See, they could fix it, but I wanted to borrow one for the work. They didn't have any album system, they told me. So, I started out and he said, wait, come back. I bought all my wreath then. He said, wait, I have a clarinet. He got up on the shelf and came down with this clarinet. And he told me it was Jimmy…
